title: Europe faces intense June heatwaves with warnings of worsening conditions
summary: Scientists warn that recurring extreme heat is a sign of global warming caused by fossil fuel use, while European nations prepare for prolonged high temperatures. The UK has issued an amber alert forecasting potential record-breaking highs near London.
summary_points: Scientists identify recurring heatwaves as evidence of climate change driven by coal, oil, and gas burning.
